app.post('/things/:id/notes', async (request, reply) => {
  const s = request.person();
  return request.tx(async (trx) => {
    const row = await trx.insertInto('note').values({ a: 1 }).returning('id').executeTakeFirst();
    return reply
      .code(201)
      .send({ id: row.id, record: await loadRecord(trx, request.params.id) });
  });
});
